name: Matthew Cree
headline: Senior software engineer
summary: Software engineer with an interest in functional programming and distributed systems. Nine years across Salesforce DevOps tooling, education platforms, security analytics and consultancy, mostly full stack, with a habit of ending up in the low-level corners: git internals, merge algorithms, 3D interfaces, Erlang.
I studied music formally before computing and still play, mainly guitar.

experience.summary: Full-stack engineer on a Salesforce DevOps platform used by over 3,000 enterprises.
points: Work deep in git internals. Found two bugs in git itself and took them to the git mailing list with repeatable reproductions and an initial diagnosis.
Take the customer issues that exceed what support can handle, and mentor newer engineers on practice and collaboration.
Pushed for written decision records and design sketches in Notion, which made technical discussions easier to follow and revisit.

projects.title: Observability
projects.note: Winner of the Computing DevOps Excellence Award for best monitoring and performance tool.
projects.body: Lead engineer. Real-time monitoring of Salesforce Flow failures and unhandled Apex exceptions. The system ingests Salesforce's auto-generated error emails, consolidates them into one view with the failed element and interview context, charts trends, and alerts on configurable rules and thresholds.
projects.stack: AWS (SES, SQS, SNS), Kubernetes, Terraform, React, TypeScript

projects.title: Semantic merge conflict resolver
projects.body: Led design and implementation. Resolves conflicts in Salesforce metadata XML by understanding its structure, covering the cases where a text merge produces invalid or wrong output, with a UI for both semantic and plain text conflicts.

projects.title: SAML single sign-on
projects.body: SAML 2.0 authentication for enterprise customers against Okta, Auth0 and Azure AD, with certificate validation, response verification and session management.

projects.title: Authorised connection management
projects.body: Role-based control over which team members can reach which Salesforce environments, with audit logging of access and permission changes.
projects.stack: C#, ASP.NET Core, React, TypeScript, Salesforce API

experience.summary: Curriculum and learning systems for over 10,000 schools in 155 countries.
points: Built MiniPD, a professional learning platform for educators, in Elixir, Phoenix and Vue.js.
Then moved to integration work connecting products across Faria's range in Ruby on Rails, CoffeeScript, AngularJS and PostgreSQL.
experience.stack: Elixir, Phoenix, Vue.js, AWS (SES, ECS, CloudFormation, RDS), Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL

experience.summary: Consultancy. Full-stack delivery across several client engagements.

projects.title: Venue modelling and audio prediction tool for Bose
projects.body: A CAD-like desktop application for sound engineers: draw the venue, place sources, and see a colour-coded sound pressure overlay that guides speaker placement. Owned application state management, the save file format and shutdown handling.
projects.stack: Electron, React, Redux, TypeScript, React Three Fiber, Three.js, Jest, Spectron

projects.title: Dependaroo
projects.body: A Bitbucket plugin that watches npm, Yarn, Gradle and Maven dependencies, raises pull requests for updates, and lets teams set policy on which updates go through automatically.

projects.title: Tyco support portal redesign
projects.body: Led the UI overhaul of the portal used by security camera integrators: legacy code to React, responsive layout, and a component library to keep it consistent.
projects.stack: React, Redux, TypeScript, SCSS, Jest, React Testing Library

projects.title: American Dynamics support portal Android app
projects.body: Knowledge base search, embedded forums, account management and biometric login, white-labelled per brand with Android product flavours.
projects.stack: Kotlin, Android Jetpack, coroutines, data binding

projects.title: File management system
projects.body: Hierarchy in RDS, files in S3, streaming uploads through a Dropwizard API, directory-level permissions and shareable links.
projects.stack: Angular, Dropwizard, Amazon S3, RDS, JOOQ

experience.summary: NGX, an Erlang system that detects security incidents from Snort and log sources.
points: Found and fixed a production bug that was silently losing customer incident data.
Extended the incident API so data scientists and front-end teams could query it efficiently.
experience.stack: Erlang, Python, MySQL, Meck, Rebar3, Docker, AWS Lambda, Kinesis

experience.summary: Night shift at the university library through my music degree and MSc: student enquiries, welfare checks, patrols, and the basement coffee shop.

education.title: MSc Computer Science, distinction
education.body: Advanced programming, distributed computing, algorithms and complexity, database systems. Built Routeline, a rail navigation app using Dijkstra's algorithm on Play Framework, and BiSignal, real-time cyclist tracking over Phoenix channels. Research project on machine learning for music recommendation.
